question: What oblation material brings a king and his retinue under control?
premises: Oleanders smeared with honey are used as offerings
The target is a king with his retinue
The rite aims to bring him under control
inference: Offerings of honey-smeared oleanders bring a king with his retinue under control.
plain_english: With oleanders smeared with honey, one should bring a king together with his retinue under control.
